rgb_profile.name: FCEUX default (FCEU0.12 and earlier), unmodified192-byte .pal
rgb_profile.rgb_values_are: display conversion choice, not RGB values stored in the NES ROM

palette_table.format: level->FF FF-terminated list of32-byte palette pointers

sprite_palette_assignment.proof: Normal player frame15 record bank4:82F8 has OAMattribute01 at headerbyte5; B407/B40A copies this toRAM38; B49C frame writer emitsRAM38.
sprite_palette_assignment.guard_group_status: proven normal guard body; individual frame-part attributes remain authoritative
sprite_palette_assignment.guard_proof: Alternate guard frame151 indexes bank4 record87E6 [01,FF,FE,04,05,02,CB,98], OAMattribute02 at byte5.

wall.apply_on: each actual8x8 base-layout nametable write, after that tile write
wall.note: Do not recolor the full56px metatile; the right24px belong to overlapping neighboring cells.

torch.attribute_extent: one containing16x16 quadrant, shared with any other pixels in that quadrant
torch.apply_order: after static room layout, through the0100 background-object queue

background_attribute_rules.other_dynamic_background_patterns: Use the header attribute_fill_pattern with the affected quadrant mask. Most patterns use0; patterns0/11 useAA (palette2).
background_attribute_rules.status_region: Separate setup modifies bottom attribute-row half-quadrants to palette3. Gameplay-grid defaults apply above the status strip.
background_attribute_rules.context_note: E533 returns the neighboring cell TYPE; zero-page59 is a tile overlay selector, not a palette index.

torch_animation.zero_color_is: universal background; tiles are written in full
torch_animation.frame_driver: bank4:AF88 follows cached background records and word lists; FFFF loops frame list

phase_state.dungeon_initial_phase: one-based torch ordinal in0100 queue order
phase_state.lookup: use oldphase to index frame pointer list, then increment phase
phase_state.ffff_loop: setphase=1 and restart lookup in same call
phase_state.frame0: used when initializedphase0; not the repeating loop target

torch_animation.timing: frame order is recovered; outer-call timing is not measured here

runtime_palette_overrides.meaning: temporary sprite-group2 replacement; triggering gameplay state is not traced here
temporary universal-background flash; timing not reconstructed by this export

reference_profile_comparison.comparison_space: sRGB after Pillow ImageCms ICC conversion
reference_profile_comparison.note: Used only to select an explicit emulator RGB conversion profile; no screenshot colors are substituted for original ROM palette indices.

limitations: A background palette applies per16x16 attribute quadrant, never independently per object or pixel.
Attribute rules here cover the normal static room pass and identified background-object queue; full dynamic screen state is not emulated.
Sprite palette selection must use each original OAM/frame attribute byte; group1 is proven for normal player frames.
PPUMASK emphasis/grayscale and analog/composite video effects are not applied by this normal RGB conversion.
The supplied screenshot selects a documented RGB profile; original colors remain the recovered ROM indices.
